# typeassert: alwaysReturns with branch statement (goto) - early false
typeassert {
	var i I
	i.M() == 1 -> i.(m1)
}
-- x.go --
package m

type I interface{ M() int }
type m1 int
func (m1) M() int { return 1 }

func F(x I) int {
	if x.M() != 1 {
		return 0
	}
	// x.M() == 1 here, but body has branch
	_ = x
	return 1
}
